name: Facet Masjid
summary: An ivory mosque is carved into one connected silhouette, with a warm side facet and two balanced towers.
why: The dome and entrance share x=54. Both minarets meet the same y=73 foundation through attached side wings. The gold plane belongs to the right half of the dome and hall, giving the architecture depth without extra symbols.
risk: The geometry is deliberately restrained. The color facet adds depth at large sizes but merges into a clear mosque silhouette in monochrome.
reasonToChoose: You want a calm mosque with clear, connected architecture and a gentle sense of depth.
